document_metadata.title: Registry Seed 001 Legacy Migration Ledger v0.1
document_metadata.note: Every audited source record or exact unique legacy label has an explicit candidate mapping, reference_only status, or needs_review status. This ledger does not claim migration is complete.
document_metadata.c25_revision_note: blocking_scope is migration-planning metadata. Grouped legacy rows do not block production of already separated candidate concepts; only unresolved First Wave identity issues are first_wave_blocker.
document_metadata.c26_revision_note: Legacy Sleep Duration mappings remain needs_review but do not block clean canonical Total Sleep Time record production. First Wave migration blockers are zero.
